content: The Prototipo RS shoes come in a Black/Red and a Red/Black/Orange colorway. Both versions feature all-day comfort with additional padding on the tongue, heel, and collar. They also include an ONSTEAM anti-microbial lining for moisture and odor control, along with a removable, contoured cork and EVA foam insole for extra comfort. The design is inspired by automotive craftsmanship, ensuring high-quality materials and construction.
